teaser: "You just have this way about you," someone says at a campsite at night, firelight catching their face, after you hand them a blanket before they thought to shiver. Life path 11 carries a pull toward insight that other people feel before they can explain it. ISFJ carries a habit of noticing what a room needs and quietly supplying it. Crossed, the warmth and the steady attention of this type become the vessel for that reach — the insight of the 11 doesn't float above the table, it serves the plate. What is particular here is how much of the shine stays unspoken, mistaken for simple kindness.
excerpt: Three boxes are taped shut and the fourth sits open on the floor, half-filled, because you stopped to ask if your partner was doing all right, mid-move.
